701:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you think you were wrong, just apologize honestly! Even kids learn that in elementary school!」

701:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Any stuck-up know-it-all who can't do that, $$トライダー$$ and I will punch until they wake up!」

701:t_102:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That courage and fighting spirit that fears nothing! I... $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$... will crush it!」

701:t_103:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, bearer of the sun. Offer your existence to me.」

701:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Our fight is for the people who wish for peace! We're not like a guy who fights with nothing to protect, like you!」

701:t_103:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I have a mission as a $$次元将$$!」

701:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Being bound by that makes you no different from a machine that just moves on orders! Remember what truly matters!!」

701:t_103:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even if I lose it, I too have things I've built up through battle! As long as they remain, I will keep fighting!!」

701:t_104:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Demon God of Light. Offer your fight to me.」

701:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You beat me and $$マジンガー$$, and then plan to go straight on to fight the $$御使い$$s? That's not happening!」

701:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「If you reject coexisting with us, I won't hesitate to fight! That's the fight of the man who was entrusted with $$マジンガー$$!」

701:t_104:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will cannot be broken even by god-killing power...」

701:t_104:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I'll crush that light! And I will surpass even the Demon God!」

701:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Spare me the talk, $$ヴィルダーク$$. In the end, you're just like $$ガイオウ$$ - you've simply been swallowed up by battle.」

701:t_105:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I don't deny it. But the same goes for you, warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$.」

701:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't lump me in with you. I'm not idle enough to fight pointless battles.」

701:t_105:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「My targets are the $$御使い$$s! If you get in my way, I'll take you down and keep going!」

701:t_105:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will of infinite evolution is the very proof of a $$ゲッター線$$ warrior! You are a man worthy of being my opponent!!」

701:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you have any feeling of mourning for the people you sacrificed, you can stop fighting!」

701:t_106:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The opposite. That is exactly why I keep fighting.」

701:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Stop it! Your mission isn't to fight! It's supposed to be to end the fighting!」

701:t_106:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you've mistaken the means for the end, I'll stop you by any means necessary!!」

701:t_106:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Such strong will... Have you completely made light and darkness one within yourself...!」

701:t_106:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will become the power to defeat them...! But I will surpass even that!!」

701:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「My drill will crush your fighting spirit!」

701:t_107:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then my fighting aura will crush that drill!」

701:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Even if my drill gets snapped, my soul will crush you!」

701:t_107:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Nothing can break me! For I have gained the power to kill even gods!」

701:t_107:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's a showdown, $$ヴィルダーク$$! Let's go all the way, and whoever wins goes on to beat the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_107:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Gladly, Spiral Man! I will surpass you, who achieved Tengen Toppa!!」

701:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$...! You, too, have a flame burning in your heart!」

701:t_108:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「A blue-white flame...! Cold and sad... but strong!」

701:t_108:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You feel my fighting aura? It's a pity you're a woman.」

701:t_108:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Men and women make no difference in a fight to protect peace! And our flame will never lose to you, who are bound by battle!」

701:t_108:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Prove those words! By fighting me!」

701:t_108:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Here I come, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

701:t_108:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll overcome everyone who stands in our way, together with $$ガンバスター$$!!」

701:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I understand now...! You, too, hold hard work and guts in your heart!」

701:t_109:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Naturally. That is the source of all fighting spirit.」

701:t_109:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I won't lose! I'll give it my all, hard work and guts, and fight you!」

701:t_109:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You've bared your fighting spirit! Now you're worthy of being my opponent!」

701:t_109:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't think you can keep playing emperor or general forever! Your fight ends here!!」

701:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You, who have lived to fight, might be the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You, who have lived to fight, might be the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You, who have lived to fight, might be the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly. We are beings of the same kind.」

701:t_110:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't become like you, who drove yourself into loneliness through fighting!」

701:t_110:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't become like you, who drove yourself into loneliness through fighting!」

701:t_110:9.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't become like you, who drove yourself into loneliness through fighting!」

701:t_110:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the destiny of the strong! If you say you've overcome it, then offer that power to me!!」

701:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「My blood is getting hot... Looks like I'm in no position to say anything about you.」

701:t_111:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is as it should be, heir to the blood of the beast. That heat is the proof that you are alive, and the primal strength of living things... in other words, life.」

701:t_111:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come at me with all your instincts! I will surpass even that!」

701:t_111:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the god-killing power...! The ultimate strength of a living thing!!」

701:t_111:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Quit talking like your own strength is already complete!」

701:t_111:5.en:
$$葵$$
「I won't stop in a place like this! I'll go beyond even you and keep going further!!」

701:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even salarymen can protect peace, so what the hell are you doing?!」

701:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「If you, who were a general and an emperor, hadn't gone about it the wrong way, you could have gathered the power to protect peace, and yet you...!」

701:t_112:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That would not beat them.」

701:t_112:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「You can't know the outcome until you try! What you did was just selfishness in the end!」

701:t_112:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I accept even those words without complaint...」

701:t_112:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will advance! I will surpass you all with this god-killing power!!」

701:t_112:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「You stubborn fool! Then the salarymen of Earth and $$ダイ・ガード$$ will snap that precious god-killing power of yours!」

701:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time for exchanging words is already past.」

701:t_113:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly. What this universe demands is power.」

701:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm disappointed, $$ヴィルダーク$$. That you, who were supposed to change that, would rely on power in the end.」

701:t_113:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then with what do you intend to stop me and the $$御使い$$s?」

701:t_113:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then you are the same as me...」

701:t_113:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is not it, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I will defeat you with power, and then deny power itself!」

701:t_113:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And then I'll tell you! That the power you believed in means nothing at all!」

701:t_113:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, Negotiator! I understand your reasoning!」

701:t_113:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then prove it! I will deny your reasoning with power!!」

701:t_114:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, Mechanical $$御使い$$! Offer me the memories of rage and hatred toward the $$御使い$$s that sleep within you!」

701:t_114:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「It's true there may be grudges of the $$天翅$$ packed inside $$アクエリオン$$...!」
